description:
Get one LinkedIn ad: full text, media, headline and link, advertiser, who paid for it,
        run dates and, for ads shown in the EU, total impressions, impressions by country and the
        targeting parameters.

        Cost: 1 credit.

        Args:
            ad_id: LinkedIn Ad Library ID (the numeric `id` returned by search_linkedin_ads).
name: get_linkedin_ad
title: Get a LinkedIn ad
